verdict.rationale: Cloud Identity docs include a 'Creating a dynamic group' topic, which supports rule-based group membership. Group-scoped policy is shown only for 2-Step Verification enforcement on specific users or groups. No evidence shows assigning apps (SAML/SSO or service access) to groups instead of to individual users. missing for 10: documented group-based app assignment, detail on dynamic-group rule syntax and how it drives access, independent or hands-on corroboration.
